title: Why Real Interest Rates Matter More Than Inflation for Gold
excerpt: A framework for understanding the relationship between inflation, monetary policy, real yields and gold's opportunity cost.
content:
Gold does not respond to inflation in a simple one-to-one relationship. The more useful question is how inflation changes monetary policy and real interest rates.

When inflation rises, markets often focus on the central bank's likely response. Higher policy rates and rising real yields can increase the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset such as gold.

This publication will use this transmission framework to analyze gold rather than treating individual economic releases as isolated signals.
